# Activities
{: .no_toc }

Fall 2026
{: .fs-5 .fw-300 }

Optional, ungraded notebooks to work through — on your own or in a group — during the Q&A sessions, while I am meeting students one at a time. Nothing here is submitted and nothing is graded. Each one opens in Google Colab in your browser; no software to install, and no Google account needed to read it. One is posted for each Q&A session.

- [Activity 0: Quotients and Homomorphic Images](downloads/public/activities/quotients-and-homomorphic-images.ipynb) — **[▶ Open in Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/eduenez/courses/blob/main/2026fall/mat5173/downloads/public/activities/quotients-and-homomorphic-images.ipynb)** — Isom⁺/Trans ≅ S¹, Spiral ≅ Rotn × Dilat⁺, ℤ/n, and S₄/A₄, with links to two companion lessons from the Erlangen Program. The link to the left downloads the raw notebook if you would rather run it yourself.
- [Activity 1: Geometric Transformation Groups](downloads/public/activities/geometric-transformations.ipynb) — **[▶ Open in Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/github/eduenez/courses/blob/main/2026fall/mat5173/downloads/public/activities/geometric-transformations.ipynb)** — Explores examples of geometric transformation groups of the plane, from rigid motions to Möbius transformations.
